description.value: The Wells Branch is a small community library serving the historic gold-rush town of Wells in BC's Cariboo region, operating as part of the 15-branch Cariboo Regional District Library network. Staffed by a community librarian, it offers borrowing services, digital resources including e-books and databases, and serves as a local community gathering point. For touring cyclists exploring this remote stretch of central BC, it provides a quiet stop with internet and community information resources.
